title: Telegraph, telephone or electric light poles on Eighth avenue between Flatbush avenue and Ninth street in Brooklyn.
officialText: Telegraph, telephone or electric light poles, except such iron poles as are now or may hereafter be erected and maintained in connection with an underground system of wires, shall not be erected upon Eighth avenue, in Brooklyn, between Flatbush avenue and Ninth street, or any part thereof, unless the consent of a majority of the owners of property in numbers and value thereof on Eighth avenue between Flatbush avenue and Ninth street first be obtained in writing, duly acknowledged in the same manner as deeds entitled to be recorded.
